run_profile_display_data: run the python profiler on ParlAI display data and print cumulative timing results
run_profile_with_truncation: run the display data profiler with output truncated to a specified number of lines
run_profile_subtract_iterdirs: run the display data profiler and subtract directory iteration time from cumulative results
setup_profiler_args: setup argument parser with profiler options including debug, truncate, and subtract iterdirs flags
profile_display_data_function: profile the display_data function using cProfile and return total cumulative time in seconds
